# Vendored FLOP Labs TCLK build

The JavaScript files in this directory are compiled without modification from
[`flop-labs/tclk`](https://github.com/flop-labs/tclk) commit
`5cc4ab93efbc8999a3a7e1471b639deca25998ea`.

They remain licensed under Apache-2.0. See `LICENSE` and `NOTICE` in this
directory. The application bundle imports this build so browser results use the
same frame decoder, signature verifier, room binding, deadlines, and state
machine as the pinned upstream implementation.
